title: Senior Backend Developer
description: About Us At Turna.com, we turn millions of travel searches and booking journeys across flights, buses, hotels, ferries and car rentals into a reliable customer experience. We are looking for an experienced backend developer who understands the business problem, asks the right questions and takes ownership of outcomes. Role and Responsibilities ● Build and improve high-traffic search, pricing,booking and post-booking capabilities. ● Keep existing systems reliable while evolving them toward simpler, scalable and maintainable designs. ● Translate business needs into technical solutions, clarify ambiguity and propose practical options. ● Treat performance, security, data consistency and fault tolerance as integral parts of design. ● Contribute actively to code review, testing, observability and technical documentation practices. ● Work with product, frontend, mobile, quality and operations teams to deliver end-to-end outcomes. Qualifications ● At least 5 years of professional backend development experience and strong proficiency in .NET. ● Hands-on experience in tourism or travel technology, preferably in flight, bus, hotel, ferry or car rental journeys. ● An analytical mindset: able to break down complex problems, connect cause and effect, and challenge assumptions when needed. ● Solid foundations in API design, data modelling, and relational and non-relational data structures. ● Practical experience with distributed systems, concurrency, integrations and production troubleshooting. ● A habit of writing readable, testable code and explaining technical decisions with clear reasoning. ● Ability to follow English technical documentation and communicate clearly within a team. This role is for someone who goes beyond completing assigned tasks: someone who understands the problem and looks for a better solution. Join Turna.com and help us build travel products that are easier to use and more dependable. https://cdn.turna.com/Documents/A-03-Calisan-Adayi-Aydinlatma-Metni.pdf

title: Expert, Backend Development
description: Çevikliğin, yaratıcılığın, yenilikçiliğin, verimliliğin ve sürekli ilerleme kültürünün benimsendiği bir iş yerinde çalışarak 1-0 öne geçmek istiyorsan, bu heyecan verici ekibin bir parçası ol! Biz kimiz? Türkiye’nin en büyük yerli iş yazılımları markası Logo Yazılım, mikro işletmelerden kurumsal büyük işletmelere kadar farklı ölçeklerdeki şirketler için uygulama yazılımı çözümlerini pazara sunuyor. Ekosistemimizde, 1.300’den fazla çalışanımız ve 900’den fazla iş ortağımızla, ülke genelinde 5.000 kişi yer alıyor. Ayrıca, 2000 yılında aldığımız unvan ile ilk halka açılan bilişim şirketiyiz. Yurt içinde ve yurt dışında önemli başarılara imza atıyor, müşterilerimizle iş birliği içerisinde tutku ve çeviklikle değer yaratıyoruz. Logo’nun çalışmak için harika bir yer olduğunu düşünen takım arkadaşlarımız ile Great Place to Work® Sertifikası™? almanın ve Türkiye’nin bilişim ve yazılım sektöründeki en iyi işverenler arasında yer almanın mutluluğunu yaşıyoruz. Misyonumuz “İş birliğinin önemine inanıyor, tutku ve çeviklikle değer yaratıyoruz.” anlayışı ile iş birliğinin önemini vurguluyor, güçlü bir takım çalışması ile çalışanlarımızın potansiyellerini ortaya koymalarını sağlıyoruz. Çeşitlilik ve dahiliyet anlayışımız Kapsayıcı bir kurum kültürü yaratmak için çabalıyor, çalışanlarımızın benliklerinin kısıtlanmadığı bir ortamda daha üretken olacağına inanıyoruz. Dünyaya karşı sorumlu birer insan olmak ve sürdürülebilir kalkınmaya katkı sağlamak için iş yerinde eşitliği savunuyor, eşit işe eşit ücret politikasını benimsiyoruz. Yenilikçi yapımız Takım çalışması ve müşteri ihtiyaçlarına odaklanırken sürekli kendini geliştiren, yeniliklere hızla uyum sağlayan, çevik metodolojiler ve yalın üretim felsefesinden esinlenerek kendine özgü tasarıma sahip olan yazılım geliştirme sürecini (Logo Agile Process Improvement System - LAPIS) kullanıyoruz. Yeni çalışma arkadaşımızda hangi özellikleri arıyoruz? Teknik Yetkinlikler: Rule engine kullanarak uygulama geliştirme deneyimi Cloud teknolojilerine hakimiyet Microservice, modular monolith, distributed systems yapıları hakkında bilgi API tasarımı, event-driven architecture ve messaging bilgisi AI/LLM tabanlı platform mimarilerine ilgi ve temel bilgi İş kuralı modelleme konusunda tecrübe Bireysel Yetkinlikler: Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme becerisi Öğrenmeye açıklık ve yeni teknolojilere adaptasyon Sorumluluk alma, inisiyatif kullanma ve sonuç odaklı çalışma Takım içi iletişim ve iş birliği Dokümantasyon oluşturma ve takip etme becerisi Geri bildirim alma ve verme kültürüne açıklık biri olduğunu düşünüyorsan, seni Logo ile 1 - 0 önde olmaya davet ediyoruz. “Expert, Backend Development” pozisyonunda neler bekliyoruz? Rule engine kullanarak uygulama geliştirme deneyimi Cloud teknolojilerine hakimiyet Microservice, modular monolith, distributed systems yapıları hakkında bilgi API tasarımı, event-driven architecture ve messaging bilgisi AI/LLM tabanlı platform mimarilerine ilgi ve temel bilgi İş kuralı modelleme konusunda tecrübe Sana neler sunuyoruz? 🕖İş ve yaşam dengesini sağlaman için esnek çalışma saatleri ⚓Yeni mesleki beceriler kazanmak isteyen çalışanlar için kariyer fırsatları 💻Profesyonel ve kariyer gelişimlerini desteklemek için öğrenme ve gelişme kaynakları 📍 Çalışanlara ve ailelerine iş ve özel yaşamlarında karşılaştıkları zorluklar için çalışan destek programı 📃Gün geçtikçe geliştirilmeye odaklandığımız çalışan yan hakları 🔮Çalışanların esenliği için hazırladığımız wellbeing programı 🎂Doğduğun ay içerisinde kullanabileceğin doğum günü izni

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Position Overview We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing product team. In this role, you'll build and ship end-to-end features for our multi-tenant B2B SaaS products — from the database schema to the API to the user interface. You'll be involved throughout the entire process — from idea to production — and become part of a team that builds high-performance, secure, and maintainable web applications. Responsibilities Develop and ship full stack features using TypeScript across the frontend (Next.js, React, Tailwind) and backend (Node.js / NestJS) Design and evolve relational data models with PostgreSQL and Prisma, including migrations Build and maintain well-documented REST APIs consumed by web clients and third-party integrations Implement background jobs, notifications, and scheduled workflows with queue-based processing (Redis / BullMQ) Continuously improve application performance, security, and reliability Collaborate with the product and design teams to plan, scope, and deliver new features Write automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) and take part in release and deployment processes Contribute to code reviews with a focus on code quality Requirements Strong experience in at least one of frontend (React / Next.js) or backend (Node.js / NestJS / Express), with genuine willingness to grow into the other Solid command of TypeScript and modern JavaScript Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and ORMs such as Prisma or TypeORM Good understanding of REST API design, authentication/authorization, and application architecture Comfortable with Git version control and team collaboration Problem-solving mindset, eager to learn, and attentive to detail Good written and verbal communication skills Nice to Have Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products and data isolation patterns (e.g. PostgreSQL Row-Level Security) Familiarity with monorepo tooling (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo) and CI/CD pipelines Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure (AWS / S3), and observability tooling Knowledge of application security fundamentals: OWASP, MFA/TOTP, encryption at rest, audit logging Experience with queue/worker architectures and event-driven design Familiarity with internationalization (i18n) and building products for multiple locales Exposure to B2B enterprise domains such as procurement, ERP, or fintech

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Remote
description: Job description ** Please note that the interview is conducted in English. We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer who thrives in building and deploying scalable, microservice-based applications. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with modern stacks, and want to have a real impact in a fast-growing SaaS environment, we’d love to meet you. About Us We’re a SaaS company with a platform originally built on Symfony 2 , with most new services developed in Node.js . Our databases include MongoDB and MySQL , and we host primarily on AWS . We’re a young, diverse, and dynamic team that moves fast, shares knowledge openly, and constantly pushes at the edge of innovation in our space. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and deploy microservice-based applications in Node.js. Build efficient, scalable APIs and services that integrate seamlessly with our platform. Contribute to architectural decisions that shape the evolution of our stack. Collaborate closely with frontend, product, and DevOps teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Share your knowledge, mentor others, and learn from a talented, international team. What We’re Looking For Strong experience in Node.js and PHP development. Proven track record of developing and deploying microservice-based applications. Familiarity with databases such as MongoDB and MySQL . Solid understanding of system design, scalability, and performance optimization. Nice to Have (Pluses): Experience with AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, etc.) or other cloud platforms. Exposure to containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. What We Offer You The chance to work on challenging problems in a growing SaaS platform . A collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture where your expertise is valued. Professional growth opportunities — expand your skills while contributing to a high-impact product. A diverse, fun, and fast-paced startup team where your work makes a visible difference.

title: Lead Backend Developer
description: Discover the future with us, where advanced technology meets innovation to revolutionize financial services! What Responsibilities Lead Backend Developer Takes? Design and implement robust, scalable, and reliable software architectures. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code; perform code reviews and optimize performance. Ensure project code quality and compliance with coding standards. Collaborate closely with architects and delivery teams throughout the development lifecycle. Troubleshoot technical problems, provide effective solutions, and lead the team in resolving them. Mentor and guide less experienced developers. Support both new and existing solutions, ensuring their stability and reliability. Research emerging technologies and evaluate their potential to enhance the existing landscape. What BtcTurk | Teknoloji Expects from You? Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or 7+ years of relevant technical experience. Strong experience with .NET technologies (Framework, Core, C#, Entity Framework, EF Core), architectural patterns such as RESTful, Microservices, and Event-Driven, as well as Unit Testing, relational databases (SQL Server or PostgreSQL), and messaging/search technologies including RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Elasticsearch. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. https://cdn.btcturk.com/technology/Calisan_Adaylari_Aydinlatma_Metni.pdf

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
company: AVL in Türkiye Research and Engineering
description: Job Description Senior Full Stack Software Engineers develop advanced components and systems to be able to handle upcoming challenges of digitalization and autonomy in automotive. They focus on developing enterprise desktop and web-based engineering software and tools. Description of daily responsibilities include, but is not limited to, the following: Design, code, test, document and maintain software solutions Requirements engineering/management Involve in R&D activities Profile Description Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Computer Engineering / Informatics, and preferably MSc and/or PhD qualifications Minimum 4 years of experience in software development Fluent speaking and excellent writing skills in English Fast learner; treats change as an opportunity to learn and develop Eager to learn state of the art technologies and techniques to come up with elegant solutions to the problems Ability to work independently, establish priorities, and proceed with objectives without supervision Willingness to frequent and long-term travel abroad Become a member of a team working on multi-national projects And a solid understanding and hands-on experience in the following topics: Object Oriented Programming (using at least one of the following languages: C#, Java, Python) Strong .NET 8 / C# backend development with REST, authentication and microservices Angular (TypeScript, RxJS) Desktop application development with Electron and frontend-backend integration Cloud-native development with Docker, Kubernetes and Azure/AWS, including CI/CD pipelines SQL databases (PostgreSQL, SQLite etc.) and data handling (modeling, performance optimization, large-scale/telemetry data) Distributed systems, event-driven architecture and scalable SaaS design patterns Git, Linux and basic monitoring/logging tools knowledge We Offer ABOUT AVL RESEARCH AND ENGINEERING TURKIYE Established in 2008, AVL Research and Engineering is an engineering center of AVL with two R&D centers in Istanbul-Türkiye that develops mobility solutions with intelligent and advanced technologies, runs national and international R&D projects and serves customers from the Turkish and the global automotive industry.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description: Overview Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. To help our teams work together effectively, this role is fully remote but requires you to be located in Turkey. We're looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team, passionately focused on delivering creative improvements for our engineering teams. Responsibilities Your future team To become a 100-year company, we need a world-class engineering organization of empowered teams with the tools and infrastructure to do the best work of their careers. As part of a unified R&D team, Engineering prioritizes key initiatives supporting our customers in moving to the cloud while simultaneously continuing to bring the most value to our customers through investments across our core product suite – including Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Bitbucket. We're looking for people who want to write the future and believe we can accomplish much more together. In This Role, You Will Build and ship features and capabilities daily in a highly scalable, cross-geo distributed environment; Be part of an amazingly open and collaborative work environment with other experienced engineers, architects, product managers, and designers; Review code with best practices of readability, testing patterns, documentation, reliability, security, and performance considerations in mind; Mentor and level up the skills of your teammates by sharing your expertise in knowledge-sharing sessions; Ensure full visibility, error reporting, and monitoring of high performing backend services; Participate in Agile software development including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, team retrospectives, and show-and-tell demo sessions; You will report directly to your Engineering Manager. Qualifications Your background: 3-4+ years of experience building and developing backend applications. Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience). Experience crafting and implementing highly scalable and performant RESTful micro-services. Proficiency in any modern object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Go, Scala, Python, etc.). Fluency in any one database technology (e.g. RDBMS like Oracle or Postgres and/or NoSQL like DynamoDB or Cassandra). Real passion for collaboration and strong interpersonal and communication skills. Broad knowledge and understanding of SaaS, PaaS, IaaS industry with hands-on experience of public cloud offerings (AWS, GAE, Azure). Familiarity with cloud architecture patterns and an engineering discipline to produce software with quality. Benefits & Perks Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . About Atlassian At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh .
